reading: Israeli opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot and Arab-led party leaders denounced Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu over claims of foreign interference after his coalition lost its majority.

Netanyahu's Likud party accused Arab-led parties of stealing the election, while the Shin Bet security agency was examining whether they had received illegal financial assistance from Qatar and Turkey.
Qatar's foreign ministry dismissed the accusations and charged Israeli politicians with conducting a disinformation campaign against Doha.
Neither Netanyahu's bloc nor the Jewish opposition secured a parliamentary majority.
The Joint List and Ra'am defied expectations by securing a record 19 of the Knesset's 120 seats after a surge in Arab voter participation.
With Netanyahu's bloc on 53 seats and Eisenkot's on 48, the Arab parties emerged as potential kingmakers, whose backing could determine who forms a government.
Likud alleged that voters had been bribed to choose Arab parties, following a request by the head of the Central Elections Committee for a security inquiry into suspected foreign interference.
Both Arab parties rejected the claim, and the Joint List described it as baseless.
What Netanyahu's critics see in the dispute is an attempt to delegitimise the Arab parties and make Eisenkot's only current route to power, an agreement with them, politically impossible.
Shin Bet clarified that its inquiry did not implicate an entire community whose members had voted legally.
The acting director general of the Central Elections Committee said there was no basis for claims of systematic breaches of election integrity.
Eisenkot cautioned that it remained too early to establish whether anything had happened and accused Netanyahu of orchestrating a campaign against the legitimacy of the results.
Many Arab Israelis had previously boycotted elections, but their participation was now motivated by a desire to oust Netanyahu's governing coalition.

The reported options for forming a government were a Netanyahu–Eisenkot unity administration, a Netanyahu coalition involving defectors from Eisenkot's bloc, or an Eisenkot-led administration backed by Arab parties.
Although Eisenkot and all but one member of his bloc had previously ruled out governing with Arab parties, speculation persisted that an agreement might still be reached.

A Hebrew University snap poll found that, among voters from each party in the opposition bloc, the most popular option was an Eisenkot minority government involving Ra'am, with the Joint List providing backing from outside the government.

vocabulary.definition: A coordinated effort to spread deliberately false or misleading information in order to influence public understanding.
Produced an outcome substantially different from what people had anticipated.
Political participants whose backing can determine who gains power, even though they do not lead the government themselves.
Lacking adequate evidence or justification; here, this expresses the Joint List's assessment of the claim.
Undermine the recognition of someone or something as valid, rightful or entitled to participate.
Connect someone with suspected wrongdoing, without necessarily establishing their guilt.
Following an organised or consistent pattern rather than occurring as isolated incidents.
Deliberately coordinating several actions towards a particular outcome; here, it suggests a planned political campaign.
Remove someone from a position of power, including through electoral or parliamentary action.
People who abandon their political group to align themselves with another side.
Declared that a particular course of action would not be considered or accepted.
A public-opinion survey conducted quickly to capture views on an immediate issue.

entries.ja: 人々の理解に影響を与えるために、意図的に虚偽の情報や誤解を招く情報を広める、組織的な取り組み。
entries.ko: 사람들의 이해에 영향을 주기 위해 의도적으로 거짓 정보나 오해를 불러일으키는 정보를 퍼뜨리는 조직적인 활동.
entries.zh-Hans: 为了影响公众的认识，有组织地故意传播虚假或误导性信息的行动。
entries.es: Esfuerzo coordinado para difundir información deliberadamente falsa o engañosa con el fin de influir en la comprensión del público.
entries.pt-BR: Esforço coordenado para divulgar informações deliberadamente falsas ou enganosas a fim de influenciar o entendimento do público.
entries.fr: Effort coordonné visant à diffuser des informations délibérément fausses ou trompeuses pour influencer la compréhension du public.
entries.de: Ein abgestimmtes Vorgehen, bei dem bewusst falsche oder irreführende Informationen verbreitet werden, um das Verständnis der Öffentlichkeit zu beeinflussen.

entries.ja: 人々が予想していたこととは大きく異なる結果をもたらした。
entries.ko: 사람들이 예상했던 것과 크게 다른 결과를 냈다.
entries.zh-Hans: 产生了与人们原先预期大不相同的结果。
entries.es: Produjeron un resultado muy distinto de lo que la gente había previsto.
entries.pt-BR: Produziram um resultado muito diferente do que as pessoas haviam previsto.
entries.fr: Ont produit un résultat très différent de ce que les gens avaient prévu.
entries.de: Führten zu einem Ergebnis, das deutlich von dem abwich, was die Menschen erwartet hatten.

entries.ja: 自らは政府を率いなくても、その支持によって誰が権力を得るかを左右できる政治勢力や政治家。
entries.ko: 직접 정부를 이끌지는 않지만, 누구를 지지하느냐에 따라 누가 권력을 잡을지 결정할 수 있는 정치 세력이나 인물.
entries.zh-Hans: 自身并不领导政府，但其支持可能决定谁能掌权的政治参与者。
entries.es: Actores políticos cuyo apoyo puede determinar quién llega al poder, aunque ellos mismos no encabecen el gobierno.
entries.pt-BR: Participantes da vida política cujo apoio pode determinar quem chega ao poder, embora eles próprios não liderem o governo.
entries.fr: Acteurs politiques dont le soutien peut déterminer qui accède au pouvoir, même s’ils ne dirigent pas eux-mêmes le gouvernement.
entries.de: Politische Akteure, deren Unterstützung darüber entscheiden kann, wer an die Macht kommt, obwohl sie selbst die Regierung nicht führen.

entries.ja: 十分な証拠や正当な根拠がないこと。ここでは、その主張に対する共同リスト側の評価を表している。
entries.ko: 충분한 증거나 정당한 근거가 없는 상태. 여기서는 해당 주장에 대한 공동명단 측의 평가를 나타낸다.
entries.zh-Hans: 缺乏充分的证据或正当依据；这里表达的是联合名单对该说法的评价。
entries.es: Que carece de pruebas o justificación suficientes; aquí expresa la valoración que hace la Lista Conjunta de la afirmación.
entries.pt-BR: Que não tem provas ou justificativas suficientes; aqui, expressa a avaliação da Lista Conjunta sobre a alegação.
entries.fr: Qui manque de preuves ou de justification suffisantes ; ici, cela exprime l’appréciation portée par la Liste unifiée sur l’affirmation.
entries.de: Ohne ausreichende Belege oder Rechtfertigung; hier drückt dies aus, wie die Vereinigte Liste die Behauptung beurteilt.

entries.ja: 人や物事について、有効である、正当である、または参加する権利があるという認識を弱める。
entries.ko: 누군가 또는 무언가가 유효하거나 정당하거나 참여할 권리가 있다는 인정을 약화시키다.
entries.zh-Hans: 削弱人们对某人或某事物具有有效性、正当性或参与资格的认可。
entries.es: Debilitar el reconocimiento de alguien o algo como válido, legítimo o con derecho a participar.
entries.pt-BR: Enfraquecer o reconhecimento de alguém ou de algo como válido, legítimo ou com direito a participar.
entries.fr: Affaiblir la reconnaissance de quelqu’un ou de quelque chose comme étant valide, légitime ou en droit de participer.
entries.de: Die Anerkennung einer Person oder Sache als gültig, rechtmäßig oder zur Teilnahme berechtigt untergraben.

entries.ja: 誰かを不正行為の疑いと結びつけるが、必ずしもその人の罪を立証するわけではない。
entries.ko: 누군가를 부정행위 의혹과 연관 짓되, 반드시 그 사람의 유죄를 입증하는 것은 아니다.
entries.zh-Hans: 将某人与涉嫌的不当行为联系起来，但不一定证明其有罪。
entries.es: Vincular a alguien con una posible conducta indebida, sin que ello demuestre necesariamente su culpabilidad.
entries.pt-BR: Associar alguém a uma suspeita de conduta indevida, sem necessariamente comprovar sua culpa.
entries.fr: Associer quelqu’un à des actes répréhensibles présumés, sans nécessairement établir sa culpabilité.
entries.de: Jemanden mit mutmaßlichem Fehlverhalten in Verbindung bringen, ohne damit zwangsläufig dessen Schuld nachzuweisen.

entries.ja: 個別の出来事として散発的に起こるのではなく、組織的な、または一貫したパターンに従っていること。
entries.ko: 서로 떨어진 개별 사건으로 발생하는 것이 아니라, 조직적이거나 일관된 양상에 따라 이루어지는 상태.
entries.zh-Hans: 按照有组织或一致的模式发生，而不是作为孤立事件出现。
entries.es: Que sigue un patrón organizado o constante, en lugar de producirse como incidentes aislados.
entries.pt-BR: Que segue um padrão organizado ou consistente, em vez de ocorrer como episódios isolados.
entries.fr: Qui suit un schéma organisé ou régulier, au lieu de se produire sous forme d’incidents isolés.
entries.de: Einem organisierten oder einheitlichen Muster folgend, statt nur in einzelnen, voneinander unabhängigen Vorfällen aufzutreten.

entries.ja: 特定の結果を目指して、複数の行動を意図的に調整していること。ここでは、計画的な政治運動を進めていることを示唆している。
entries.ko: 특정한 결과를 얻기 위해 여러 행동을 의도적으로 조율하고 있는 것. 여기서는 계획적인 정치 운동을 벌이고 있음을 시사한다.
entries.zh-Hans: 正在为达到某个特定结果而有意协调多项行动；这里暗示正在开展一场有计划的政治活动。
entries.es: Estar coordinando deliberadamente varias acciones para lograr un resultado concreto; aquí sugiere que se está llevando a cabo una campaña política planificada.
entries.pt-BR: Estar coordenando deliberadamente várias ações para alcançar um resultado específico; aqui, sugere que está em andamento uma campanha política planejada.
entries.fr: Être en train de coordonner délibérément plusieurs actions pour obtenir un résultat précis ; ici, cela suggère qu’une campagne politique planifiée est en cours.
entries.de: Mehrere Handlungen bewusst auf ein bestimmtes Ergebnis hin aufeinander abstimmen; hier deutet dies darauf hin, dass eine geplante politische Kampagne betrieben wird.

entries.ja: 選挙や議会での行動などによって、誰かを権力のある地位から退かせる。
entries.ko: 선거나 의회 활동 등을 통해 누군가를 권력을 가진 자리에서 물러나게 하다.
entries.zh-Hans: 使某人离开掌权的职位，包括通过选举或议会行动实现。
entries.es: Apartar a alguien de una posición de poder, incluso mediante acciones electorales o parlamentarias.
entries.pt-BR: Retirar alguém de uma posição de poder, inclusive por meio de ações eleitorais ou parlamentares.
entries.fr: Écarter quelqu’un d’une position de pouvoir, y compris par des moyens électoraux ou parlementaires.
entries.de: Jemanden aus einer Machtposition entfernen, auch durch Wahlen oder parlamentarische Maßnahmen.

entries.ja: 所属する政治集団を離れ、別の陣営につく人々。
entries.ko: 자신이 속한 정치 집단을 떠나 다른 편에 합류하는 사람들.
entries.zh-Hans: 离开自己所属的政治团体，转而投向另一阵营的人。
entries.es: Personas que abandonan su grupo político para aliarse con otro bando.
entries.pt-BR: Pessoas que abandonam seu grupo político para se alinhar a outro lado.
entries.fr: Personnes qui quittent leur groupe politique pour se rallier à un autre camp.
entries.de: Menschen, die ihre politische Gruppe verlassen, um sich einer anderen Seite anzuschließen.

entries.ja: 特定の行動方針について、検討も受け入れもしないと明言した。
entries.ko: 특정 행동 방안을 고려하지도 받아들이지도 않겠다고 선언했다.
entries.zh-Hans: 已明确表示不会考虑或接受某种特定的行动方案。
entries.es: Declararon que no se consideraría ni se aceptaría una determinada línea de actuación.
entries.pt-BR: Declararam que determinada linha de ação não seria considerada nem aceita.
entries.fr: Ont déclaré qu’une ligne d’action particulière ne serait ni envisagée ni acceptée.
entries.de: Erklärten, dass ein bestimmtes Vorgehen weder in Betracht gezogen noch akzeptiert würde.

entries.ja: 目の前の問題について人々の意見を把握するために、短期間で実施する世論調査。
entries.ko: 당면한 사안에 대한 사람들의 의견을 파악하기 위해 신속하게 실시하는 여론조사.
entries.zh-Hans: 为了解人们对当前某个问题的看法而迅速开展的民意调查。
entries.es: Encuesta de opinión pública realizada con rapidez para conocer las opiniones sobre un asunto de actualidad.
entries.pt-BR: Pesquisa de opinião pública feita rapidamente para captar as opiniões sobre uma questão do momento.
entries.fr: Sondage d’opinion réalisé rapidement pour recueillir les avis sur une question du moment.
entries.de: Eine rasch durchgeführte Meinungsumfrage, die Ansichten zu einer aktuellen Frage erfasst.

review.method: separate ChatGPT plan translation and independent editing sessions
